QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Endless Training
QuestInfo.0: Sloth and pride are no-nos! Duel with the senior apprentices to challenge yourself!
QuestInfo.1: The master suggests you visit the first senior apprentice if you want to duel with the faction members. But don't overwork yourself! This chance is only available up to 10 times a day.
QuestInfo.2: The master suggests you talk to the first senior head apprentice anytime you want to find challenge your skills. You got a gift for training diligently.

default.0: Haven't you won 50 duels yet? Wait a bit and try again.
